title: Fix maintenance_check's falsy-zero bug misclassifying deliberately-scored anti-example tools as unscored
plan: quality_score 0 is a real, deliberate score (mine_feeds/gemini_video_analyze template defaults to 1; the model explicitly overrides to 0 for hype/anti-example mentions); not t.get('quality_score') treated that falsy-but-real 0 identically to a missing score -- switch the check to is None
outcome: shipped: src/maintenance_check.py's 'Tools with no quality score' detector no longer flags the 6 tools (Air Canada Chatbot, Builder.ai, Dragontail, Google Slides, Klarna AI assistant, NomadGo Inventory AI) that were already explicitly scored 0 by the mining pipeline as anti-examples of AI hype -- confirmed by reading data/tools.json directly (all 6 have quality_score:0, none None/missing) and by reading mine_feeds.py/gemini_video_analyze.py's own prompt template, which defaults quality_score to 1, meaning 0 only appears when the scoring model deliberately overrode it below the useful range. Verified before/after: maintenance_check health score 57->58 (issue_count 6->5, the false-positive issue type disappeared, nothing else changed). guardrails 18/20, 0 critical (same 2 pre-existing unrelated misses as fire 119). excava_core_test: all checks passed (unrelated, sanity check only).
